User.title: User
User.description: Student or Admin profile containing credentials, learning metrics, and settings.

mobile.description: Unique phone number of the user.

name.description: Name of the student or staff member.

signupDate.description: ISO date string representing when user signed up.

role.description: Privilege and operational role of the user.

village.description: Associated village or digital hub location.

totalPoints.description: Total accumulated points (XP) earned from various activities.

lastCheckedInDate.description: The date of the last check-in.

earnedCertificates.description: JSON stringified array of earned certificates.

claimedMedals.description: JSON stringified array of claimed medals.

mascotLessonsHistory.description: JSON stringified array of lessons historical metrics.

completedMilestones.description: JSON stringified array of completed learning milestones.

checkInDates.description: JSON stringified array of check-in dates.

dailyStudyLog.description: JSON stringified object tracking daily minutes.

updatedAt.description: High-precision epoch timestamp for LWW replication conflict resolution.

puzzleStreak.description: Number of consecutive puzzle completion days.

puzzleSubjectProficiency.description: JSON string mapping subjects to proficiency levels.

puzzleStrongTopics.description: JSON string array of well-mastered concepts.

puzzleWeakTopics.description: JSON string array of concepts requiring reinforcement.

puzzleStatsByClass.description: JSON stringified object mapping class names to standard-specific puzzle metrics.

/users/{mobile}.description: User profile document containing progress metrics and config.
